name: lead-intake-v1
description: SyncSet GBP + Website Lead Intake Pipeline — captures enquiries from multiple sources → Notion CRM → Telegram alert → auto-response email → follow-up timers → booking tracking

trigger.name: Lead Submission (Website / GBP)
trigger.description: Receives lead data from syncset.com.au website form and (future) Google Business Profile messages

expected_payload.name: string (lead's full name)
expected_payload.message: string (enquiry message or reason for contact)

example_payload.name: Jane Smith
example_payload.message: We get 20+ WhatsApp enquiries a day and can't keep up. Interested in learning more about how SyncSet could help.

steps.name: Receive & Validate Payload
steps.error_handling: If payload missing required fields (name, email, business): → Log error to Telegram + discard

steps.name: Clean Lead Data
steps.action: Trim whitespace, normalize email to lowercase
steps.error_handling: If email invalid format: → Alert Paulo, skip step 3–5

steps.name: Create Notion Lead Record
steps.action: Create new database record in 'SyncSet Leads' table
steps.error_handling: If Notion API fails: → Log to Telegram, store payload to backup Airtable table, retry in 5 min

steps.name: Send Telegram Alert
steps.error_handling: If Telegram API fails: → Continue; log separately; manual sweep every 4 hours

steps.name: Send Auto-Response Email
steps.subject: Your Workflow Audit is 1 click away — SyncSet
steps.error_handling: If email send fails: → Log to Telegram, mark as 'email-bounced' in Notion, do NOT attempt retry

steps.name: Set 24-Hour Follow-Up Reminder
steps.action: Wait 24 hours; if lead has NOT booked by then → Trigger follow-up email
steps.condition: IF Notion record.Booked? == 'No' AND time_since_created >= 24 hours
steps.error_handling: If webhook timeout: → Treat as missed follow-up; log to Telegram

steps.name: Send 24-Hour Follow-Up (Conditional)
steps.action: If Step 6 condition true: send 1st follow-up email

steps.name: Set 72-Hour Follow-Up Reminder
steps.action: Wait additional 48 hours (72h total); if still NOT booked → Trigger final follow-up
steps.condition: IF Notion record.Booked? == 'No' AND time_since_created >= 72 hours

steps.name: Send 72-Hour Follow-Up (Conditional, FINAL)
steps.action: If Step 8 condition true: send 2nd (final) follow-up email
steps.error_handling: Same as Step 5; after this email, no further contact unless lead responds

steps.name: Monitor Cal.com for Booking
steps.action: Every 15 minutes: check Cal.com API for new bookings matching lead email
steps.query: SELECT bookings WHERE guest_email == clean_lead.email AND booking_time > raw_payload.timestamp
steps.error_handling: If Cal.com API unavailable: → Log, retry next cycle; manual check daily

steps.name: Update Notion on Booking (Conditional)
steps.action: If booking detected: update Notion record
steps.error_handling: If Notion update fails: → Log to Telegram; manual update Paulo

steps.name: Send Booking Confirmation to Lead
steps.action: If Step 11 succeeds: send calendar event + confirmation

steps.name: Add Event to Google Calendar
steps.action: Create calendar event in Paulo's personal calendar
steps.error_handling: If Google Calendar API fails: → Log to Telegram; manual entry

error_paths.action: Log error to Telegram, discard, return HTTP 400
error_paths.recovery: Manual review and re-entry by Paulo

error_paths.action: Store payload in backup Airtable, alert Telegram, retry Step 3 in 5 min
error_paths.recovery: If retries fail after 3 attempts: manual Notion entry + email to lead

error_paths.action: Mark lead as 'email-bounced', alert Telegram, do NOT retry
error_paths.recovery: Paulo contacts lead via alternative method (phone, Telegram if available)
Manual sweep of Notion 'New' status every 4 hours

error_paths.action: Mark as 'No Response' in Notion, stop follow-ups
error_paths.recovery: Manual outreach by Paulo if desired; no automatic further contact

test_payloads.name: Happy Path: Form submission with email

payload.name: Alex Johnson
payload.message: We receive 15+ booking requests on WhatsApp daily. Very interested in streamlining.

test_payloads.expected_result: Lead created in Notion, Telegram alert sent, welcome email sent, follow-ups scheduled

test_payloads.name: GBP Message (Future): Direct message from GBP

payload.name: Maria Garcia
payload.message: Saw your profile on Google, sounds like exactly what we need

test_payloads.expected_result: Same as happy path; source logged as 'gbp-message' for attribution

test_payloads.name: Error Case: Invalid email
test_payloads.expected_result: Error logged to Telegram, lead skipped, HTTP 400 returned

test_payloads.name: Edge Case: Lead books immediately
test_payloads.expected_result: Lead created, booking detected within minutes (Step 10 short-circuit), confirmation sent, follow-ups cancelled

email_templates.name: Welcome Email
email_templates.subject: Your Workflow Audit is 1 click away — SyncSet
email_templates.body:
Hi {lead.name},

Thanks for reaching out. Your 20-minute workflow audit is ready to book.

👉 Book your time here: https://cal.com/syncset/workflow-audit

No prep needed. We'll spend 20 minutes learning where your enquiries come in, where they get stuck, and what we could actually fix.

If you have any questions before the call, just reply to this email.

Cheers,
The SyncSet team

email_templates.name: Follow-up Email #1 (24 hours)
email_templates.subject: Just checking in — Workflow Audit booking
email_templates.body:
Hi {lead.name},

Just a gentle nudge — if you're still interested in the workflow audit, the calendar is open:

👉 https://cal.com/syncset/workflow-audit

Feel free to pick any time that works. Questions? Hit reply.

Cheers,
SyncSet

email_templates.name: Follow-up Email #2 (72 hours, FINAL)
email_templates.subject: Last opportunity: Workflow Audit booking
email_templates.body:
Hi {lead.name},

One last heads-up — we've got a couple of audit slots available this week if you'd like to grab one:

👉 https://cal.com/syncset/workflow-audit

If now isn't the right time, no worries. Feel free to reach out anytime you're ready.

Cheers,
SyncSet

email_templates.name: Booking Confirmation Email
email_templates.subject: Workflow Audit confirmed — {booking.time}
email_templates.body:
Hi {lead.name},

Awesome! Your audit is scheduled for {booking.time} (AEDT).

📅 Add to your calendar: [ICS attachment]
📞 Zoom link: [Cal.com link]
❓ Questions: Reply to this email anytime

Looking forward to learning about {lead.business}.

Cheers,
SyncSet

steps: 1. Log into make.com (https://make.com) with your Make account
3. Choose 'Webhook' as the trigger module (Step 1 above)
4. Copy the webhook URL generated by Make
5. Configure each step in the UI using the module list above (Webhook → Text Aggregator → Notion → Telegram → Email → Delays → Google Calendar)
6. Map fields from previous modules to next modules using Make's visual connector
7. For Notion: authenticate with your Notion workspace, select 'SyncSet Leads' database, map fields as shown in Step 3
8. For Telegram: get bot token from @BotFather on Telegram, set channel to @Paulo_leads_bot
9. For Email: use a service like Postmark or SendGrid (pre-configured); use templates provided above
10. For Google Calendar: authenticate with your Google account
11. For Cal.com: set up Cal.com API key (Settings → Integrations → API)
12. Test with sample payloads (see test_payloads section above)
13. Once working: share webhook URL with frontend developer to embed in form submission endpoint

himl_rules.condition: After 5 test leads tracked by Paulo
